item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 12/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be cloudier and windier over the region. With the easterly airstream weakening, it will become humid over the coast of southern China during the weekend. It will be warm during the day. The northeast monsoon is expected to affect Guangdong early to midweek next week. The weather will be slightly cooler over the region.
